description: Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority - The Tourism (Registration and Licensing of Ayurvedic Tourist Health Care Centers) Regulations, No. 03 of 2019
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by a Minister under the Tourism Act, No. 38 of 2005, specifically the "Tourism (Registration and Licensing of Ayurvedic Tourist Health Care Centres) Regulations No. 3 of 2019." It establishes legal requirements, registration procedures, licensing conditions, and compliance standards for businesses operating Ayurvedic Tourist Health Care Centres. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes as it creates new regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements under existing legislation.
